crashes.name: Bike physics broke after a hard hit
crashes.what: A big crash or a fence hit can push the bike's physics past what the game can compute. The next part of the game that reads the bike then goes to desktop.

crashes.name: Track objects drawn to bad memory
crashes.what: The batch that draws gates, signs and crowds writes through a vertex pointer that is no longer valid.

crashes.name: Tyre or trainer name the game can't print
crashes.what: A missing tyre folder or a damaged trainer file hands the game's text formatting something that is not text.

crashes.name: Bike asks for a tyre that isn't installed
crashes.what: Building the bike list with a tyre that is not loaded reads past the tyre table.

crashes.name: Overlays and other plugins
crashes.what: The crash is in another program loaded into the game: the Discord overlay, a HUD plugin or a ReShade add-on.

crashes.name: 124 rarer crashes
crashes.what: Sites with only a few reports each. Each one is traced once it shows up often enough.

crashes.name: Graphics driver
crashes.what: The crash is inside the AMD or NVIDIA OpenGL driver. Updating or reinstalling the driver is the fix.

crashes.name: Someone joins your server mid-handshake
crashes.what: When you host from the game's menu, a joining rider the game can't find leaves a reply unwritten, and the host copies lists of any length.

crashes.name: Texture loaded without the memory for it
crashes.what: While content loads in the menus, the game builds a texture's smaller versions in memory it never checks it got.

crashes.name: Bike list read after leaving a session
crashes.what: A menu screen keeps a bike index that no longer exists after a session ends.

crashes.name: Unnamed crash 0x2889E0
crashes.what: Not traced yet. Being worked through, biggest first.

crashes.name: Water wake after the track unloaded
crashes.what: The wake effect updates one more frame after the track freed it.

crashes.name: Menu list line naming a missing item
crashes.what: A menu list draws a line for an item it no longer has.
